commonPromptCore: Single isolated production ground decal. Direct orthographic 90-degree overhead view, no perspective. Grounded muted painterly realism, low saturation, dark soil, charcoal and umber. Diffuse flat lighting, no cast shadow. True transparent PNG alpha, square canvas, centered motif approximately 80 percent of canvas width. Soft irregular ragged porous edges, no round stamp, backing tile, text, UI, glow, cartoon outlines or repeated patterns. Readable at 96-160 pixels on dark forest grass, moss, soil and leaf litter.
